name: Divider
description: Thin line that separates two groups of content. It is the shortest contract in the system: use it as a starter example.

dos: Use it to separate distinct groups of content, not every item in a list.
If it is purely decorative, set `decorative` so screen readers ignore it.

donts.why: A line between every pair of elements clutters the screen; the spacing already separates them.

donts.case: Drawing a border around a block
donts.why: A Divider is a standalone line, not a frame.

props.name: orientation
props.description: horizontal: full-width line. vertical: full-height line.

props.name: decorative
props.description: true: purely decorative and hidden from screen readers. false: announced as a separator.

a11y.name: Needs no accessible name.
a11y.contrastNote: Decorative or structural: text contrast is not required. If it separates important areas, check that it is visible against the background.
